data.content: Rainy Sunday. Takeshi wants to take Rin fishing; Rin is mid-raid.

Rain's coming down steady. Good day for it, fish bite better in the murk.

Rin's got the headphones on, so that's a raid, not a hobby. I'll give it twenty minutes, then pull the plug on the router like the old days.

tell dad if he unplugs the router i'm unplugging his tackle box. permanently.

boss is at 4%, i can fish after. the fish aren't going anywhere, that's the whole point of fish.

Tackle box is older than you, it's survived worse. Four percent my foot, that's the lie bosses tell you.

Fine. Tide's not till noon anyway. But you're baiting your own hook, no exceptions.

it's not a lie, it's a phase. we're wiping on the last phase because the healer keeps eating the cleave. actual tragedy.

fine. i'll bait it. just don't narrate the tide like a nature documentary.
The rain suddenly stops and the sun comes out.

Sun's out. Rain quit on us, and the fish will go shy in the glare. That's the thing about timing, you wait for it, it waits for nobody.

Grab your jacket, we're going now. Healer can eat the cleave without you.

raid's over. we downed it, tell dad he can keep his tackle box.

gimme five minutes, i'm wiping sweat off these headphones. nobody told me sunday shift went outdoors.

Five minutes, then I start the truck. This engine's got a schedule and it don't care about your loot.

Downed the boss, eh? Good. Fish today are gonna wish they had a healer. Come on, sun'll be gone by two.

give me three, i need a jacket and my other shoes are still wet from friday.

dad's gonna talk about barometric pressure the whole drive, bet. i'm bringing earbuds.

Three minutes. Clock's running, kid.

Barometric pressure's why the whole trip exists. Rain stops, sun dries the surface, bass go deep. Earbuds stay in the bag or I'm tuning the radio to the fishing report. Right on schedule.

it's not the pressure, you just like saying pressure.

truck bed's still wet so i'm in the cab with you. no fishing report or i'm putting my own playlist on, and you know it's all raid music.
